facts.fact: Huawei's case study says NOSi's national data centre, delivered in 2014 in phase one, saw rapid growth of service leasing to third parties and was expanded in phase two to 1,000 VMs; NOSi also provided data centre hosting services for Equatorial Guinea, Mozambique, Burkina Faso, Guinea-Bissau and Sao Tome and Principe; the page gives no date beyond the 2018-07-05 published date, which is used.

Huawei's case study says NOSi's national data center hosts the eGovernment cloud, on which NOSi developed more than 150 websites and 77 eGovernment applications for all government departments, schools, hospitals and state-owned enterprises; capacity was raised to 1,000 VMs and 1,000 TB in phase two. Dated to the page's inferred publication date, 2018-07-05.
